dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Thanks for the help! That was over a lot faster than I expected!

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: I'm sure you have places to be, so don't let me keep you. Rest assured, I'll keep the people around here safe.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Be careful out there! I know victory will be ours!
